cheer.c1: Let's start with the easy part.
cheer.c2: A friendly face and a few words.
cheer.c3: Nearly a third of the way there.
cheer.c4: A third of the way there. About three minutes to go.
cheer.c6: This one decides who can see you.

say.s1: Hi, I'm Link. I ask one small question at a time, so nobody fills in a form here.
say.s2: Lovely to meet you, {name}. Now a face and a few words.
say.s4: Lovely, {name}. Now the fun part: what do you love teaching?
say.s5: Who do you teach, and where?
say.s6: What kind of work are you open to? This decides who can see you.
say.s7: If you like, share proof of your experience. Links only, never documents.
say.s8: Last question about you: how can members reach you?
say.s9: Before you publish, one honest thing…

q.s2: Tell members a little about you
q.s6: What work are you open to?

help.s1: First name and an initial is enough, like Emily R. No numbers, links or contact details.
help.s2: A photo is optional. Please don't put phone numbers, emails or links in the text: you add contact details near the end, and members see them only when they ask.
help.s5: Members see areas on the map, never an address.
help.s7: Link to proof hosted by the issuer, starting with https://. We store links, never documents.
help.s8: Only paying members see these, and only when they ask. Add the ones you really check. At least one is needed to publish.

reassure: Only paying members can see this. You can hide it any time.

fields.rateGoes: Your hourly rate goes to families only. Schools never see it.

preview.title: Your card builds as you answer
preview.rateNote: Your rate goes to families only. Schools never see it, and families never see your school-work wishes.
preview.schoolsNotTutor: Schools see only your school-work side.
preview.invisible: Nobody sees you in this view until you choose what you are open to (step 6).
preview.safeTitle: Nothing is public until you publish.
preview.safeBody: Hide or delete your card any time, in one click. We never ask for your ID, home address or documents.
